title: Chunking notes
acceptance: Given text, then short paragraphs merge, long ones split on sentences, and trivial text is dropped.
evidence: PR 1: chunking tests; chunk size tuned after a real query returned a mixed passage.

title: Local embeddings and search
acceptance: Given notes and a query in different words, then the matching passage ranks first with at most three per note.
evidence: PR 1: retrieval test; four paraphrased queries returned the right passage first in Chrome.

title: On-device storage
acceptance: Given added notes, then they persist in IndexedDB and can be removed individually or cleared.
evidence: manual: PR 1, persistence checked across reloads in Chrome.

title: Memory map
acceptance: Given passages, then a 2D projection places them deterministically and matches glow.
Given the map, then the user can zoom, pan, reset and see each note labeled at its center.
evidence: PR 1: PCA tests. PR 2: zoom, pan and labels checked in Chrome.

title: Mobile layout
acceptance: Given a 390 px viewport, then the map appears first and nothing overflows horizontally.
evidence: manual: PR 2, measured in Chrome at 390 px.
